description: This file defines Express.js routes related to the dashboard overview in a Node.js backend. It includes middleware to verify authentication and tenant requirements, as well as a route for metrics that currently returns a 404 status indicating removal of the endpoint.

methods.name: router.use
methods.description: Adds middleware functions to the router stack, applying authentication, tenant verification, and tenant bypass logic.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/metrics' endpoint, currently responding with 404 indicating the endpoint's removal.
